mapper.select: SELECT * FROM section_profiles WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL) ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM section_profiles WHERE section_id = #{sectionId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO section_profiles ( task_id, section_id, section_name, region_code, bank_id, dem_id, source_case_id, interval, deepest_index, slope_foot_index, point_count, profile_data, user_id ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{sectionId}, #{sectionName}, #{regionCode}, #{bankId}, #{demId}, #{sourceCaseId}, #{interval}, #{deepestIndex}, #{slopeFootIndex}, #{pointCount}, #{profileData}::jsonb, #{userId} ) ON CONFLICT (task_id, section_id) DO UPDATE SET section_name = EXCLUDED.section_name, region_code = EXCLUDED.region_code, bank_id = EXCLUDED.bank_id, dem_id = EXCLUDED.dem_id, source_case_id = EXCLUDED.source_case_id, interval = EXCLUDED.interval, deepest_index = EXCLUDED.deepest_index, slope_foot_index = EXCLUDED.slope_foot_index, point_count = EXCLUDED.point_count, profile_data = EXCLUDED.profile_data, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id, deleted_at = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE section_profiles SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)
UPDATE section_profiles SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE section_id = #{sectionId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO section_profiles ( task_id, section_id, section_name, region_code, bank_id, dem_id, source_case_id, interval, deepest_index, slope_foot_index, point_count, profile_data, geom, user_id) SELECT #{newTaskId}, ns.section_id, p.section_name, p.region_code, p.bank_id, p.dem_id, p.source_case_id, p.interval, p.deepest_index, p.slope_foot_index, p.point_count, p.profile_data, p.geom, #{targetUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} FROM section_profiles p JOIN cross_sections os ON os.section_id = p.section_id AND os.task_id = #{srcTaskId} JOIN cross_sections ns ON ns.task_id = #{newTaskId} AND ns.section_id = 'sec-' || #{newTaskId} || CASE WHEN os.section_id LIKE #{srcPrefix} || '%' THEN substring(os.section_id FROM char_length(#{srcPrefix}) + 1) ELSE '-copy-' || os.id END WHERE p.task_id = #{srcTaskId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.id
